title: The dashboard lists only notifications the user may see
statement: The dashboard MUST list only the notifications the signed-in user may see, under the scope ruled for q-notification-list-scope.
why: An unscoped list leaks another organisation's notifications.

acceptance.text: Given two users in different organisations each with a notification, when either user opens their dashboard, then only notifications within the ruled scope are listed.

falsifiedBy: A dashboard listing a notification outside the ruled scope.

sources.quote: Should a user see only their own organisation's notifications?
